purpose: Mandatory research standard for every municipality and relevant housing activity. A municipality review is incomplete until both legal rules and the practical application package are researched or explicitly marked as dynamically determined by the official application route.

required: submission channel: Omgevingsloket, municipal portal, form, email/post or other official route
application form URL or form name where applicable
fees/leges only when current and reliably sourced
processing period only when current and reliably sourced
official source for every material application requirement

documentEvidenceRules.omgevingsloketDynamicRequirements: If the exact attachment list is generated only after answering questions in Omgevingsloket, record applicationDocumentsMode=dynamic-omgevingsloket and do not manufacture a static document list.
documentEvidenceRules.conditionalDocuments: Record the trigger/condition for conditional documents rather than presenting them as always required.

completionStates.complete: Both legal rule and practical application requirements are current and evidenced for all applicable activities in scope.
completionStates.complete-dynamic-documents: Legal rules are complete and official route confirms documents are determined dynamically during the application flow.
completionStates.legal-complete-application-open: Legal rule is researched but application route/documents still need confirmation.
completionStates.application-complete-legal-open: Application route/documents are known but substantive legal rule is not fully consolidated.
completionStates.targeted-research-required: A specific legal or application requirement remains unresolved after mandatory retest.

qaGates: No municipality may be marked research-complete if an applicable permit has no application-process status.
No required-document list may be copied from another municipality without a current official source for the municipality being reviewed.
Expired forms, fee schedules and regulations must be rejected explicitly.
Unknown is preferable to an inferred document requirement.
Every future legal-review batch must update application-document coverage and the central backlog.
